description: One time step (dt = 10 years) of the enthalpy-based energy model (EnthalpyModel) and the ice-age model (AgeModel), both forced entirely by the verification test F exact solution: u3 = U(r,z) x/r, v3 = U(r,z) y/r, w3 = w(r,z), strain heating Sigma = Sig*rho*c, surface temperature T_s(r) = Tmin + ST*r, geothermal flux 0.042 W/m^2 (the Ggeo of the exact solution). The initial enthalpy is the exact steady-state temperature field (converted with the model's own standard EnthalpyConverter), so one step produces only the discrete-vs-continuous response; the age model starts from age = 0.

regenerate.command: cd stage1 && source runs/env.sh && instrument/instrument_energy -Mx 31 -My 31 -Mz 61 -dumps_dir stage1/dumps -dt_years 10
regenerate.note: Writes stage1/dumps/energy/ and stage1/dumps/age/. Override grid with -Mx/-My/-Mz, step with -dt_years, parent dir with -dumps_dir.

test_F.note: constants.ice.density (910), specific_heat_capacity (2009), thermal_conductivity (2.1) match the exact solution's rho/cpheat/k

setup.energy_initial_state: exact temperature field via EC->enthalpy_permissive(T_exact, 0, p), using the context's standard EnthalpyConverter (pressure-dependent T_m)

dump_files.energy/parameters.csv: energy.*, constants.*, grid.*, enthalpy_converter.* config keys
dump_files.energy/inputs.nc: geometry, cell_type, all 9 forcing fields, E_in, E_out, basal_melt_rate
dump_files.energy/columns.csv: per (i,j,k): geometry, depth, surface_temp, u3/v3/w3/sigma, E_in, E_out, T_exact

checks.energy_near_steady: deep-interior |E_out - E_in| ~ 2 J/kg (near the exact steady state); the top ice level is pulled ~1 K toward the surface Dirichlet BC (discrete-vs-continuum surface mismatch)
checks.energy_temperate_base: where T_exact > T_pmp (deep interior near the dome) the model clamps to temperate: 57 temperate cells, basal melt rate up to 0.0037 m/yr at the dome base
checks.energy_ice_free: E_in == E_out at ice-free margin cells (both set to the local surface-temperature enthalpy)
checks.age_interior: age = dt exactly in the deep interior (ice ages one second per second from age 0)
checks.age_surface: age = 0 at the surface; the age-0 layer advects down ~w*dt and the top ~2 coarse levels carry the surface transition
checks.age_max: max age after one step = dt
